description: This file defines the LanguageAPI class, which extends AbstractInstallerRestController and provides an API endpoint to retrieve a list of languages supported by the installer module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: API controller providing access to language data for the installer process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of available languages from InstanceCreationHelper.
